article.title: CTC-IWI Conference: Presentation by IWI President, G. Mavrikos
article.author: admin
article.content: Trump called Cuba a dictatorship. What we saw here in Cuba yesterday is that almost 7 million Cubans put their signature to defend their homeland and filled the streets in a glorious May Day Demonstration. We saw millions of Dictators in Cuba who are determined to dictate their own future against the US intervention and blockade! Our enemies are strong and they have guns, but we have a nuclear weapon and this is our Internationalism! Now it is time we put our signature for Cuba.
